display_long_description:
SprintAR is an Augmented Reality training app.

It lays out different patterns of training cones for sprinting, football, soccer or basketball. Automatically records lap times and shows a **ghost replay for you to chase!**

[media]

- Never measure out training cones (witches hats) ever again!
- Never have to collect them back up again, either :)
- Includes many different cone patterns (no need to research them)

# For personal trainers and coaches

- Impress students with the latest technology
- When running, students see a guide where to go next
- Forces students to go round cones properly
- Optionally use soccer balls or basketballs
- Designed to quickly hand off the headset from one student to the next

# For students

- Chase a ghost of the best time!
- See your time instantly
- Practice multiple patterns, in the same space, with no setup time

**SAFETY WARNING: never expose the inside of your VR headset (where the lenses are) to direct sunlight**
